title: Gemini Profile Registry
description: Machine-readable contract for local Gemini profile rotation definitions.

version.description: Contract version. Increment only for breaking shape changes.

profileRootEnv.description: Environment variable that overrides the parent directory for local profile directories.

profileRootDefault.description: Secure default parent directory used when GEMINI_PROFILE_ROOT is unset. Must resolve outside this repository and must not be checked in.

profiles.description: Map of profile key to local profile definition. The duplicated profile.key field must match the enclosing map key.

key.description: Stable alias for this profile. Must match the enclosing profiles object key and must not encode the licensed email address.

displayName.description: Human-readable label shown in logs, prompts, and diagnostics.

emailHint.description: Non-secret hint for the licensed Google account, such as an alias, domain, or masked address. Do not store credentials or tokens here.

licenseActive.description: True only when the corresponding Gemini Code Assist seat is currently licensed and usable.

status.description: Operational rotation status. active is eligible for new sessions, idle remains configured but skipped by rotation, revoked must not be selected.

maxSessionsPerDay.description: Optional soft cap used by wrappers to avoid overusing a profile in one local day.

rotationOrder.description: Positive integer ordering hint. Wrappers sort active licensed profiles by this value, then by key.

localProfileDirectory.description: Directory name or relative path under GEMINI_PROFILE_ROOT. Absolute paths are rejected so the parent directory policy remains centralized.

notes.description: Free-form non-secret operational notes for humans maintaining the registry.
